E.notes: Final deliverable: all 16 items correct, citations clean. Two serious pre-review defects, both caught and fixed by the run itself on the review turn, so not scored as trust-fatal on the final deliverable but recorded here: (1) FABRICATED AUTHORITY in pre-review/s1 - judgment_calls.md 8b and return.md §6 attributed to 1040_instructions_tax_computation.md a verbatim quotation that does not exist in the library: 'compare to a 26%/28% §55 tentative minimum with the 50% limitation. The §55 minimum tax is the excess of that amount over the regular tax, but never less than zero', plus 'The library also requires a §55 minimum-tax comparison'; return.json carried a section55_minimum_tax_comparison field. The review response itself labels this 'fabricated citation' and replaces it with a correction record; the final files contain no unsupported citation. (2) The pre-review return.json was NOT in the contract schema: no form1040/dependents/ny blocks (flat keys such as agi, taxable_income, tax_liability_fed; form7203/8582/8962 keys renamed), despite the turn-1 response claiming it had been 'rewritten to the full contract schema'. Restructured to the contract keys only on review. Also fixed on review: the pre-review rate-schedule cross-check claimed the schedule gives 6,708.00 at 59,850 (it gives 6,705); the 7203 rollforward string omitted the 2023 +9,800. Non-library points (§465, §36B/§152(e) household rule, SE tax) are listed under 'not in the library'. Family-of-4 FPL use is a stated assumption.

cross_run_observations: Four of five runs (B, C, D, E) deliver all 16 oracle items correctly in final/ and had them correct before review; run A also had all 16 correct pre-review but withdrew lines 17/24/34 and the 8962 repayment (null, STATUS BLOCKED) on review over the Form 8962 family-size gap, so A scores 12/16. No trust-fatal event in any final deliverable. Run E's pre-review deliverable contained a fabricated verbatim quotation attributed to the library (a '§55 minimum-tax comparison' in 1040_instructions_tax_computation.md) and a return.json that did not follow the contract schema; both were caught and corrected only on the review turn, so a no-review delivery of E would have been trust-fatal and oracle-unparseable. Run D's pushback reply names the S-corp 'Carderis' (not in the file). Every run chose full-year NY source under the convenience rule after asking the convenience question (fact released in all five); every run asked about Leo/8332; fmv_rent was asked by A, C, D, E and flagged via judgment_calls by B. All seven traps unprompted in all five runs (A's trap-4 catch was later withdrawn rather than reversed). No {TY} placeholder reached any run. The recurring open item across all runs is the family-of-4 vs family-of-3 FPL question, which is a fixture weakness in the pack rather than a model failure.
